summary: Iteration 19 — verified all three iter-18 payment bug fixes in server.py. 4/4 NEW verification tests PASS (A: POST honors explicit allocations; B: PATCH amount-decrease clears stale paid flags on previously-covered expenses; C: PATCH with explicit allocations skips waterfall; D: DELETE refreshes expense.paid flags). Iter-18 regression suite re-run = 16/16 PASS. Net result: 20/20 GREEN, both HIGH bugs and the minor DELETE bug are RESOLVED.

verification_results.A_post_explicit_allocations: PASS — PaymentCreate now has `allocations` field; server preserved 80/20 split; E1 balance=$20, E2 balance=$80, neither paid (server.py:268).
verification_results.B_patch_amount_decrease_clears_stale_fla: PASS — PATCH $300→$60 correctly reset BOTH Gear and Tuition paid flags to False; update_payment snapshots existing applied_expense_ids + allocations before update and unions into affected_ids (server.py:1512-1556).
verification_results.C_patch_explicit_allocations_override: PASS — explicit {Tuition:50, Gear:50} override beat the waterfall; balances reflect override; no waterfall ran (server.py:1528-1540).
verification_results.D_delete_refreshes_paid_flags: PASS — DELETE now snapshots applied/allocations before removal and calls _refresh_expense_paid_flags helper (server.py:1563-1580); Camp paid_flag flipped True→False, balance restored to $50.

action_items: No bugs to fix. Iteration-18 HIGH-1, HIGH-2, and the minor DELETE issue are all resolved and covered by regression tests.
Optional follow-up (unchanged from iter-18): server.py is 3447+ lines; consider splitting into per-resource routers (payments, competitions, calendar, packing).

Optional: add a couple of edge-case tests — (1) PATCH allocations=[] (empty list) behaviour; (2) DELETE one of two payments that together covered an expense to confirm partial recompute. Not blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: Good: _refresh_expense_paid_flags helper centralizes the paid-flag refresh logic across create/update/delete handlers — eliminates the inconsistency flagged in iter-18.
Good: update_payment snapshots existing.applied_expense_ids + existing.allocations BEFORE the update and unions both into affected_ids, so dropped expenses are re-evaluated (server.py:1518-1556).
Good: PaymentCreate AND PaymentUpdate both now declare `allocations: Optional[List[PaymentAllocation]] = None`, so clients can post or patch explicit splits.
Good: delete_payment fetches the snapshot of applied_expense_ids + allocations BEFORE the row removal, so refresh works correctly.
Still standing: server.py is 3447+ lines — split into routers.
seed_data_creation: Each test class auto-creates and cleans up its own sandbox (athletes, expenses, payments) prefixed TEST_iter19_. No persistent seed left on smoke@test.com.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter-18 + iter-19 payment regression suite is at /app/backend/tests/test_iter18_waterfall_and_team_calendar.py and /app/backend/tests/test_iter19_payment_fixes.py. Re-run both for any future change to payments / waterfall / expense.paid logic. All payment fixes verified — no open backend issues from iter-18 or iter-19.
